instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. In a bright indoor office with white walls, the woman in the black sweater (R1) stands on the left, gesturing with both hands open and palms facing up. The man in the blue suit (R2) stands on the right, facing her and listening. The woman gestures with open hands while speaking to the man, who stands opposite her. Soft natural light illuminates the scene, creating a clean, neutral color palette.
elements: R1 is the active speaker who gestures with both hands open
